messages:
sara: NexaHealth pinged — they got a surprise $9.9k burst charge on their Dedicated commit for Mar. Ticket attached (SUP-6789).
jon-fin: Paste the lines?
sara: invoice INV-3321 snippet:
```
INV-3321
- Reserved commit (Mar): $8,500
- Burst overage (cross-region failover 03/05 01:22-01:55 UTC): $9,900
Total due: $18,400
```
mike-cs: Customer says this was triggered during our scheduled regional kernel maintenance. They were routed to eu-central briefly. They expect maintenance waiver per our maintenance policy.
ops-bot: Maintenance window: 2026-03-05T01:20Z - 2026-03-05T02:00Z. Change: kernel patch eu-central scheduled. Auto-failover enabled. (changelog link)
jon-fin: Our standard policy: scheduled maintenance should not bill as burst if we proactively reroute or inform customers with an opt-in. Did we notify Nexa?
sara: AE log shows no pre-warning sent. Ops acknowledges the patch but says it was low-impact.
mike-cs: Customer is unhappy — asking for full waiver of burst plus expedited refund. Also threatening to shift some traffic if unresolved.
jon-fin: Suggestion: since this was during a scheduled maintenance window and was our action, offer full waiver of the $9,900 burst. Also add a one-time promotional credit of $1,000 on next invoice for goodwill. Approve?
mike-cs: Approve from CS side if finance signs off. Will coordinate messaging.
jon-fin: Approve. I'll create CN-3321-1 for $9,900 + promo CN-3321-2 for $1,000? Or combine as $10,900 single CN? Preference: single CN with breakdown for accounting.
sara: Please tag reason=maintenance-waiver in the credit note. Also set collection hold.
billing-bot: Creating credit note CN-3321-1 (amount $10,900) with internal memo: "maintenance-waiver + goodwill promo". Applied hold on INV-3321. Collection pause in place.
jon-fin: Filing follow-up: FIN-924: "Add maintenance notification check to scheduled patch runbook to avoid billing surprises." Assign to platform + billing.
mike-cs: I'll send the message to Nexa: explain we found it happened during our scheduled kernel patch, we will apply a $10,900 credit (covers burst + $1k goodwill), and refund if payment already captured. ETA 24h.
sara: Thanks. Keep thread updated when CN posts and refund processed.
billing-bot: Refund queued if payment captured. REF-INV-3321 scheduled. ETA 2 business days.
sara: Closing — thanks team. :handshake:
